spans.text: ...At the Griffin temporary command post.
Um, there you are, Commander...
I was only able to reunite with my sister Gr G3 thanks to you.
Still...now isn't the time to celebrate the joy of seeing her again...
Big Sis Gr G3 asked me to tell you that the echelons fighting with Sangvis units are running low on supplies, but the Sangvis forces keep increasing in number and they're under a lot of pressure.
Therefore, she hopes that you can re-establish a supply line to them, Commander...
This is also a request of mine, I want to help my sister...so please, help us.
...Click.
Commander, Honey Badger here.
I've finished scouting the area you indicated earlier.
The Military and S.F. are fighting there. If we want to continue forward, we'll need to circle around them.
Looks like the situation has gotten worse... But any risk is worth taking for my sister...
Commander, let's begin...the operation!
It's good to be motivated, but don't forget to reinforce me in combat!
Nobody else matters besides Gr G3's safety...
Hey, wait a minute. What did you just say?!
...I was just kidding.
After all, these are dangerous times. We can only survive if we work together...I think.
Hey, so you mean it doesn't matter under normal circumstances?!
...Ahh, forget it.
Commander, I'll coordinate my movements with you.
Let's all do our best! Now's the time to show your courage and overcome the trials before you!
